_comment: Second clip's ingest manifest — a Real Madrid counterattack from best-goals-2025-30s.mov (a DIFFERENT real goal than the hero, so the codegen hint genuinely differs). Mirrors clips/single-goal/manifest.json field-for-field. `source` resolves relative to this dir. Ground truth was re-established by watching the source video directly: the counterattack segment runs ~7870-14820ms (see `video`), the scorer (white-shirted #7, Vinicius) is legible at 10000ms, and the REAL goal moment is ~14250ms — a PRIOR revision of this manifest carried a fake-fixture-derived goal@10500 and a stale nearest_box that came from that same fake fixture; both were wrong and are corrected here. The sampling window 9000-14800ms at fps 8 -> stride 125, so both the legible scorer frame (10000 = 9000 + 8*125) and the real goal moment (14250 = 9000 + 42*125) are sampled. No jersey digit is ever hand-typed into the cache: the pin below only DISCLOSES the expected read ('7'); scripts/precompute.py requires a REAL gpt-4o VLM read of the full-person crop to agree before writing read_text, hard-failing (GroundingError) on a mismatch.

pins._comment: Renames the detection nearest this box (at the legible 10.0s frame) to the semantic id `p_vini`. The match box is the real (re-verified against the source video) white #7 scorer's person box at 10000ms. The read is DISCLOSED, not hardcoded: precompute.py requires a live gpt-4o VLM read of the FULL-PERSON crop (not the jersey box) to actually read '7' before it will write read_text for p_vini — a mismatch hard-fails the precompute run (GroundingError), the honest human-verification gate. (A prior revision's nearest_box was derived from a fake fixture and is retired.)

read.note: The white #7 is human-legible at 10.0s; gpt-4o vision reads the full-person crop and is expected (and verified live) to read 7.

events._comment: The REAL goal moment of this counterattack, established by watching the source video (best-goals-2025-30s.mov) directly. scorer_pin refers to the pin det_id (p_vini); the pipeline derives events[].scorer_det FROM the pin resolution so the join key stays byte-identical across detect/read_text/events. (A prior revision carried ts_ms=10500 and a matching box, both derived from a fake fixture — that goal moment was never real and is retired.)
